attribution.XXBT: Explain what this figure is before recording it. write_baseline.py refuses to run for any asset without an attribution, because freezing an unexplained discrepancy makes it permanent and invisible.

note: Copy to reconciliation-baseline.json and generate with scripts/write_baseline.py. Records the gap between exchange balances and this bot's trade log at a point in time. The gap is expected to be non-zero — an account usually predates the bot and may carry manual trades. The check alerts on MOVEMENT away from these figures, not on their size.
